g.text: J02 import rule: the whole incoming file is
parsed and validated first, then replaces the
accepted catalogue in one step. On invalid or
empty input the accepted catalogue is kept and
Keyed by code: a repeated import overwrites the
same products, so listings are not duplicated.
importedAt is the app's retrieval time; sourceDate
stays null because the file provides no date.
price is nullable. A missing price is unknown,
stored as null - never 0 - and never wins a
comparison. offer keeps the original multi-buy
text; it is never divided into a unit price.
productCode, quantity, checked and addedAt only.
No price is copied into the list, so the list
survives a restart and no stale amount is shown
